title: For ports that are DOWN, list the port name, network ID, MAC address, admin
question: For ports that are DOWN, list the port name, network ID, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, bound security group ID, and the minimum admin_state_up value in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by port ID, but only include security groups that are bound to more than 5 DOWN ports. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH down_ports AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.name,
    p.network_id,
    p.mac_address,
    p.admin_state_up,
    p.status,
    p.device_owner,
    sgb.security_group_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb ON sgb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
sg_counts AS (
  SELECT security_group_id
  FROM down_ports
  GROUP BY security_group_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
)
SELECT
  d.name,
  d.network_id,
  d.mac_address,
  d.admin_state_up,
  d.status,
  d.device_owner,
  d.security_group_id,
  MIN(d.admin_state_up) OVER (
    ORDER BY d.id
    ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
  ) AS min_admin_state_up
FROM down_ports d
JOIN sg_counts s ON s.security_group_id = d.security_group_id
ORDER BY d.id
